tests.title: New with a workspace returns an index without goroutines, processes, walks or disk writes

tests.title: The codesearch module has the required path, replace directive, pinned zoekt, header comment and files

tests.title: codesearch/README.md leads with the go/no-go figures and records the pinned-zoekt answers

tests.title: The gate figures in the README meet the fixed thresholds, otherwise nothing of the spec is present
